DDBLI.Step1: 1. Click "Open D&D Beyond" below. It opens a new tab to your campaigns using your current login.
DDBLI.Step2: 2. Pick your campaign, then click into the character you want.
DDBLI.Step3: 3. Copy that character's link from your address bar (or just the ID number) and paste it below.
DDBLI.Step4: 4. Click "Get Character JSON." It opens the raw data in a new tab.
DDBLI.Step5: 5. On that page, press Ctrl+A then Ctrl+C to copy it all.
DDBLI.Step6: 6. Click in the box below, press Ctrl+V, then click "Import Character."
DDBLI.ImportFailedParse: That doesn't look like D&D Beyond character data. Did you copy the whole JSON page (Ctrl+A, Ctrl+C) and paste it (Ctrl+V) into the box?
DDBLI.ImportFailedEmpty: The box is empty. Copy the character JSON page (Ctrl+A, Ctrl+C), then click in the box and press Ctrl+V.
DDBLI.GMOnly: Only the GM can import D&D Beyond characters.
DDBLI.SettingSyncBasicsHint: Race, background name, gender, age, biography -- see the individual toggles just below for finer control over exactly which of these sync. (Portrait always syncs regardless of this.)
DDBLI.SettingSyncAbilitiesHint: Ability scores, HP, skill and saving-throw proficiencies.
DDBLI.SettingSyncExtrasHint: Spells, feats, class features, and the background feature.
DDBLI.SyncPanelMenuHint: Quick sync: pick one or more D&D Beyond-linked characters by portrait and sync just those. See Sync Settings for the category toggles and the manual (console-paste) flow.
DDBLI.SyncAllStep1: 1. Click "Open D&D Beyond" below. It opens a new tab, already logged in as you.
DDBLI.SyncAllStep3: 3. On the D&D Beyond tab, press F12 to open the console, paste (Ctrl+V), and press Enter. It fetches every linked character and copies the results for you.
DDBLI.SyncAllStep4: 4. Come back here, click in the box below, press Ctrl+V, then click "Sync All."
DDBLI.ScriptCopied: Script copied. Paste it into the D&D Beyond tab's console (F12) and press Enter.
DDBLI.SyncAllResult: {done} synced of {total} character(s), {failed} still need the manual step.
DDBLI.SyncAllResultsEmpty: The box is empty. Paste the results from the D&D Beyond console first.
DDBLI.SyncAllResultsParseFailed: That doesn't look like the results from the fetch script. Copy the console's output (it should already be on your clipboard after pressing Enter there) and paste it here.
DDBLI.NoLinkedCharacters: No characters linked yet. Import one first with "Import from D&D Beyond" -- once it's linked, it shows up here.
DDBLI.PortraitHint: Click one or more portraits to select them (amber glow = selected), then click "Sync Selected."
DDBLI.SyncSelectedResult: {done} synced of {total} character(s), {remaining} still need the manual step.
DDBLI.SettingProxyUrlHint: Address of your DDB Scraper Proxy add-on (e.g. https://ddb-proxy.example.com), with no trailing slash. When set, importing/syncing a character tries this first and auto-fills the paste box for anything set to Public on D&D Beyond -- no copy/paste needed for those. Leave blank to always use the manual flow.
DDBLI.ProxyStatusFetched: Fetched automatically via proxy -- click "Import Character" below.
DDBLI.ProxyStatusUnavailable: Not available via the proxy (likely private) -- use the manual steps below.
DDBLI.ProxyAutoFetchHint: Fetches every linked character through your proxy automatically. Only characters set to Private on D&D Beyond need the console steps below.
DDBLI.ProxyAutoFetchResult: {done} auto-fetched of {total} character(s), {remaining} still need the manual step.
DDBLI.SyncSettingsMenuHint: Category toggles for what syncs, plus the manual (console-paste) Sync All flow for characters the proxy can't reach. For everyday syncing, use the Sync Panel instead.
DDBLI.SettingSyncDetailsFieldClassHint: Class and subclass levels, as Items.
DDBLI.SettingSyncDetailsFieldSpeedHint: Walk, fly, swim, climb, and burrow speed.
DDBLI.SettingSyncAbilitiesFieldHpHint: Max HP, current HP, and temp HP.
DDBLI.SettingSyncGearFieldItemsHint: Weapons, armor, and other inventory items.
DDBLI.SettingSyncGearFieldCurrencyHint: Platinum, gold, electrum, silver, and copper.
DDBLI.SettingSyncExtrasFieldFeaturesHint: Feats, class features, and the background feature.
DDBLI.SettingSyncBasicsFieldNameHint: Keeps the actor's Name matched to D&D Beyond on every resync. Turn off to freeze a name you changed by hand in Foundry -- a brand-new import always gets the D&D Beyond name once regardless, since a new actor needs one.
DDBLI.SettingSyncBasicsFieldBiographyHin: Backstory, personality, ideals, bonds, and flaws.
